app/settings_open_source_footer: <string name="settings_open_source_footer">Lumen is free and open source. Bugs and ideas are welcome on GitHub.</string>
app/settings_permissions_footer: <string name="settings_permissions_footer">Lumen works without these; they unlock the features named. Each opens Android\'s settings.</string>
app/settings_reduce_motion_subtitle: <string name="settings_reduce_motion_subtitle">No flying photos, springs or bounces</string>
app/settings_resize_message:
<plurals name="settings_resize_message">
        <item quantity="one">Saves new copies of %d photos next to the originals.</item>
        <item quantity="other">Saves new copies of %d photos next to the originals.</item>
    </plurals>
app/settings_resize_message_one: <string name="settings_resize_message_one">Saves a new copy next to the original.</string>
app/settings_software_update_footer: <string name="settings_software_update_footer">Updates come from Lumen\'s releases on GitHub. Checking only asks GitHub for the latest version; nothing about you or your photos is sent.</string>
app/settings_suggested_footer: <string name="settings_suggested_footer">Folders that look like software projects: their images are usually icons and build files.</string>
app/settings_update_allow_install: <string name="settings_update_allow_install">Allow Lumen to install apps, then tap Install again</string>
app/settings_update_confirm_message: <string name="settings_update_confirm_message">Downloads the update from GitHub, then Android asks to install it.</string>
app/settings_update_confirm_message_size: <string name="settings_update_confirm_message_size">Downloads the update (%1$.0f MB) from GitHub, then Android asks to install it.</string>
app/settings_update_not_signed: <string name="settings_update_not_signed">This update isn\'t signed like your Lumen, so it wasn\'t installed</string>
app/smart_cutout_footer: <string name="smart_cutout_footer">Touch and hold a person, pet or thing in a photo to lift it off the background, then copy, share or save it. Works on this phone, without the internet.</string>
app/smart_cutout_remove_message: <string name="smart_cutout_remove_message">Touch and hold won\'t lift subjects out of photos until you download it again</string>
app/smart_downloads_footer: <string name="smart_downloads_footer">Models download once from Hugging Face; your photos and searches never leave this phone.</string>
app/smart_faces_footer: <string name="smart_faces_footer">Groups photos and videos by person, in Collections → People. Name people to find them in Search.</string>
app/smart_faces_no_npu: <string name="smart_faces_no_npu">No compatible NPU detected. Accurate needs a supported Snapdragon NPU.</string>
app/smart_faces_people_found:
<plurals name="smart_faces_people_found">
        <item quantity="one">%1$,d people found</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$,d people found</item>
    </plurals>
app/smart_faces_people_so_far:
<plurals name="smart_faces_people_so_far">
        <item quantity="one">%1$s · %2$,d people so far</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$s · %2$,d people so far</item>
    </plurals>
app/smart_faces_remove_message: <string name="smart_faces_remove_message">People, their names and merges are deleted; downloading again finds everyone from scratch</string>
app/smart_hf_token_remove_message: <string name="smart_hf_token_remove_message">Downloads will go without it. It\'s stored encrypted on this phone only.</string>
app/smart_index_on_battery_subtitle: <string name="smart_index_on_battery_subtitle">Keep scanning off the charger; stops when the battery runs low</string>
app/smart_indexed_complete: <string name="smart_indexed_complete">New photos and videos are added as they arrive</string>
app/smart_runs_on_needs_accurate: <string name="smart_runs_on_needs_accurate">This phone\'s NPU runs the Accurate model only.</string>
app/smart_runs_on_npu_failed: <string name="smart_runs_on_npu_failed">The NPU didn\'t pass Lumen\'s check, so it isn\'t used: %1$s. Lumen tries again after an update.</string>
app/smart_runs_on_npu_ready: <string name="smart_runs_on_npu_ready">The NPU version is on this phone: new photos are indexed on the NPU.</string>
app/smart_runs_on_npu_waiting: <string name="smart_runs_on_npu_waiting">The NPU version for this phone downloads on Wi-Fi while Lumen is open.</string>
app/smart_schedule_footer_off: <string name="smart_schedule_footer_off">Index the backlog at a time you choose, like overnight, instead of whenever the phone charges.</string>
app/smart_schedule_footer_on: <string name="smart_schedule_footer_on">Photos and videos are indexed only in these hours, plugged in or not (it stops if the battery runs low or the phone gets warm). New photos are still added as they arrive. Unplugged, Android lets background work run only now and then at night, so it\'s fastest on the charger.</string>
app/smart_search_footer: <string name="smart_search_footer">Find photos by what\'s in them, like “cat asleep on a sofa”. Accurate finds more and understands many languages; Fast is smaller and quicker to set up, in English.</string>
app/smart_search_remove_message: <string name="smart_search_remove_message">Searching by what\'s in photos stops working until you download it again. Text, faces and subtitles stay</string>
app/smart_subtitles_footer: <string name="smart_subtitles_footer">Tap CC on a video to make subtitles on this phone. Works for English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish speech; music without speech gets none.</string>
app/smart_subtitles_remove_message: <string name="smart_subtitles_remove_message">CC can\'t make new subtitles until you download it again. Subtitles already made stay</string>
app/smart_text_footer: <string name="smart_text_footer">Search the words in photos, screenshots and videos, like a name in a chat. Reads Latin scripts, Chinese and Japanese.</string>
app/smart_text_read_complete: <string name="smart_text_read_complete">Words in photos and videos are searchable</string>
app/smart_text_remove_message: <string name="smart_text_remove_message">Searching the words in photos stops working, and the words read so far are deleted</string>
app/smart_unrestricted_battery_subtitle: <string name="smart_unrestricted_battery_subtitle">Lets indexing keep going after you leave Lumen; otherwise Android holds it back</string>
app/smart_video_detail_subtitle: <string name="smart_video_detail_subtitle">Frame size for faces and text in videos; lower is faster on older phones</string>
app/smart_video_text_footer: <string name="smart_video_text_footer">How many frames each second are read for text. More frames catch quicker captions. Never more than the video has. Applies to videos read from now on.</string>
app/smart_video_text_max_frames_subtitle: <string name="smart_video_text_max_frames_subtitle">In long videos. 0: no limit; above it, that many spread through the video</string>
app/smart_video_text_slow: <string name="smart_video_text_slow">More frames make reading slower: every frame takes a fraction of a second, so 10 a second reads a 1-minute video about 5 times slower than 2 a second.</string>
app/viewer_allow_location: <string name="viewer_allow_location">Allow location access to see where photos were taken</string>
app/viewer_wallpaper_hint: <string name="viewer_wallpaper_hint">Drag and pinch to frame it</string>
engine/ai_ru_indexing_desc: <string name="ai_ru_indexing_desc">Progress while Smart Features read your library</string>
engine/ai_ru_text: <string name="ai_ru_text">Reading text in photos and videos</string>
